import z3

def get_unsat_core(constraints_z3, tracker_prefix="c"):
    solver = z3.Solver()
    trackers = []
    for i, c in enumerate(constraints_z3):
        tracker = z3.Bool(f"{tracker_prefix}_{i}")
        solver.assert_and_track(c, tracker)
        trackers.append(tracker)
    
    if solver.check() == z3.unsat:
        core = solver.unsat_core()
        core_indices = [int(str(t).split("_")[1]) for t in core]
        return core_indices
    return []  # SAT, no conflicts
